en: Black‑and‑white view of a large decorative fountain in a tree‑lined city park. The fountain has a tall central column with figures and an upper bowl, from which strong jets of water arc outward into a circular basin. Benches and flowerbeds surround the fountain, and a person in the foreground sits on a chair looking toward it. Printed white text at the bottom identifies the scene as a fountain in the city park of Graz and credits a local publisher.
